The organization and the ticket to read. The /organizations/support/tickets/read API accepts requests in the following format:

ReadSupportTicketRequest Model - Request body to read a support ticket.
organizationId string
required
example: 5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691
Id of the organization.
hash string
required
Id of the ticket.
Example 
{
  "organizationId": "5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691",
  "hash": "string"
}
